verdict.rationale: gstack keeps its accumulated learnings locally as JSONL under ~/.gstack/projects/{slug}/learnings.jsonl, an open and portable format, and the /learn skill explicitly supports exporting what it has learned. Per-site domain skills are also saved as notes the agent writes for itself. However, the evidence covers only learnings and skills, not a documented 'export everything and leave' path. missing for 10: a documented comprehensive export covering all gstack data (including any telemetry-collected usage data), specification of the export format, and independent or hands-on confirmation that leaving loses nothing.
